bullets.content: [general] After every solve read the top-5 hotspots (location, nearest face, local h). If hotspot local h equals global h, the refinement radius missed them: widen radius to hotspot distance + 2 elements. Place refinements from the first solve's hotspots, not uniform-h sweeps.

[general] After EVERY solve call view(kind=error) and compare(new, anchor/finest) before submit; list each hotspot's local h vs requested and whether it lies in a refinement box. Repeatedly skipped. Use all 4 solves, one as an in-run anchor.

[general] One factor per solve, literally. Write each solve's single changed parameter in the thought before calling mesh(). Obey your own fallback thresholds: if a free mesh breaks them (e.g. q<0.12), run the fallback free mesh before solve.
[general] Before each solve, check the free-mesh node delta from the added refinement. If under ~2% of nodes, the change is a no-op; replace it with a structural change.
[general] Pick between near-equal solves by DOFs and energy with a written inequality, never by the estimator's absolute % (drifts ~1.5x from true error). Above target, base ∝ 1/(e·DOFs).
[general] Setup (fixed f12, pressure on f7 at 2.1e6, E 210 GPa, nu 0.3) matched the statement and equilibrium held. Do not spend a solve on setup.

[abc_00000065_bc0] CONTROL recipe = g6 S4 (h 0.007 o2, edge22, f7, slab 0.002, arm 0.0042, f9/f38 0.0035 r0.004, top box 0.0036): 17397 DOFs, 8.59%/5.25%, base 0.712 (task best). Change only one thing from it.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Single tweak: thin slab box [0.017,-0.009,-0.0082,0.028,0.013,-0.0062] 0.0017 r0.002 covering hotspots #1-#5 (~43% energy, local h 0.0025-0.0028). Goal local h<=0.0022, +300-600 nodes. Alt self idea: 0.0016 r0.003, dropping f9/f38 to pay.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Check min_quality on tweak mesh: S4 sits at q 0.112 near 0.1 limit. If q<0.105 use thin box size 0.0018 r0.003; never lower global h for quality.

[general] Ladder: S1 = exact S4 recipe (anchor, expect 2.13415e-4 at 17397). S2 = + thin slab box. S3 = thin box y-max 0.012->0.018 (hotspot #6 y 0.0164, h 0.00425) only if S2 pays. S4 = best or none.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Accept tweak only if written out: DOF rise % < est. error drop %; proxy energy up >=0.1e-6 J per +1k DOFs and slab hotspot share near f5/f7 falls from 43%. Else submit anchor-equivalent.
[abc_00000065_bc0] After EVERY solve incl. the submitted one: compare(anchor,new) + view(kind=error, view=-z). Skipped on S4 and previous run: REPEATED. No submit without them.

[general] Slab +y end near f4 under-refined (a1 #5 4.1% h 0.0039 y 0.0162; a3 #6 y 0.0164 h 0.00425; grid cell y 0.0144 holds 6% at h 0.0033). Extend slab/band y-max to 0.017 at 0.002 r0.003 after thin slab; est. -0.2-0.3 pt for <500 DOFs.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Adding f9+f38 together cut nodes 6046->5756 and energy 2.13545->2.13214e-4: mesher re-laid slab. When an addition lowers both nodes and energy, check element size near f5/f7 and hotspot h; add one group per solve.
[abc_00000065_bc0] h 0.007 beat h 0.011 on same recipe: 2.13206e-4 vs 2.13545e-4 at 18138 vs 18903 DOFs. a1 tests h next generation; don't re-run h ladders.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Top box [0.015,-0.024,0.002,0.03,-0.008,0.0082] 0.0036 cost only 43 nodes, yet check-point RMS 5.25% vs a1's 7.83% without that box family. Keep -y arm-top protections (they decide hidden-point bonuses); don't spend a solve testing it alone.

[general] DOF sinks: f12 ~937-1070 touching, f13 ~694, f5 ~608-788, while -x half and far arm f52 are black on error maps. Future DOF-cut test (not control): arm box 0.0042 x-min 0.012->0.015. Don't chase f5 coarsening.
[general] Diversity: keep h within 1.5x of peers; a0 recipe at h 0.007 is diversity-eligible. Fallback: if free mesh >7000 nodes or q<0.12 use h 0.0072; never above 0.0073.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] a2 anchor (h 0.01, f7 0.0032 r0.008, edge22 0.003 r0.008, f5 0.0038 r0.006, band 0.002 r0.003, f9/f38 0.0035 r0.004, top box 0.0036) gave 8.17%/4.72% at 21033 DOFs, q 0.17. Slab 0.0017 gave +0.1% energy for +1182 DOFs: saturating; don't chase finer slab sizes.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] a0's through-thickness arm box (z -0.0035..0.0082 at 0.0042) and finer small-hole faces f27-f34 (h 0.0027-0.0031 vs 0.0042-0.0046) won more hidden-point bonus (0.156 vs 0.094) at similar DOFs. Test at h 0.007.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Disclosed P2 (0.0217,-0.0209,0) has -19.8% error; worst hidden point near f12 y -0.0375. Try point refinement at P2 (0.003 r0.005) and test f12 near y -0.037 to cut check-point RMS.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] h 0.0065 (19404 DOFs, 8.57%, 2.13420e-4) and h 0.007 (18744, 2.13295e-4, q 0.241) break even; h 0.0065-0.007 minimises nodes (0.0055:7305; 0.006:7029; 0.01:7011; 0.008:7557; non-monotonic). Global h is not the lever; pick h once, no sweeps.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Coarse global h exhausted on a2 recipe: h 0.013→8475 nodes, 0.014→7157 (q 0.226), 0.015→q 0.068, 0.016→q 0.058, 0.02→q 0.055. Never above 0.014 there.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Full-thickness arm box [0.013,0.012,-0.0082,0.03,0.022,0.0082] at 0.0038 added 1415 nodes (+20% DOFs) for +0.03% energy. Never refine whole arm thickness.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Split band (slab [0.017,-0.016,-0.0082,0.03,0.012,-0.006] 0.0018 + upper band 0.003) with f5 r0.005 gave 24.2k DOFs, energy 2.13194e-4, vs single 0.002 band 2.1347e-4 at 21.5k. Two factors changed, unattributed. Keep single 0.002 box; if retried, change only the split, f5 r0.006.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Top-side grid cells y~0.014-0.027 (z>0) show 70-230% local error but hold only ~2% of error energy each. Low priority; do not refine there.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Hotspots #1-#5 (40.6% of energy) sat at z -0.0072..-0.0076, x 0.019-0.027 (clamp slab). #6 at y 0.0153 near f4 (3.9%) is the slab's +y end, not the upper arm. Check each hotspot's z before boxing; arm boxes stay inside z -0.0082..-0.006.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Acceptance by base ∝ 1/(e·DOFs): +X% DOFs must cut field error by factor 1/(1+X). Rough: e² ≈ 1 - U/2.151e-4, so 8.17% ↔ 2.1358e-4. Use only to rank your own solves, never as truth.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Field 8.57% and check-point 8.42% (was 5.19%) are tied; lowering e needs both slab and scattered points improved. Judge by energy per DOF plus compare. S1 vs S3: +0.2 pt error vs -3.4% DOFs is break-even; prefer higher min quality (0.241 vs 0.112). Write inequality each time.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Top-side cells (z>0, y 0.014-0.027) and low-stress points (P1 -7.75% at 4.5e4) show big local error but tiny energy; ignore. Hidden check RMS 5.47% (worst 8% near f13 y -0.0375); slab drives score.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Stop tiny h sweeps (<0.5% energy change per solve). Use each solve for one structural change, e.g. different refinement target or dropping the top box to cut DOFs.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Setup (f12 fixed, pressure 2.1e6 on f7, E 210 GPa, nu 0.3) correct, equilibrium held. Do not spend a solve on it.
